title: Just okay
text: Just okay. This travel neck pillow is okay. It does it's job, and offers some neck support while traveling. It is not, however, as comfortable as other neck pillows I have tried. It's just something about the way the neck sits on it that just doesn't feel right, and is fatiguing. Maybe it's the weird contouring. I don't know, but I don't recommend this one.

product_metadata.title: Emolli Travel Neck Pillow - Compressible Memory Foam Pillow, Ergonomic Washable Cover with Portable Bag Gift for Car Airplane Traveling (Black)
